messages.content:
Diagnosis:
The test `testToClass_object()` calls `ClassUtils.toClass()` with an array containing an object, a null element, and another object. The test expects the output to be an array of Classes where the class of each object is returned, and for the null element, the class array should contain null.

Looking at the `ClassUtils.toClass(Object[] array)` method, the code iterates over the input array and attempts to call `array[i].getClass()` for each element to get its class. However, if any element in the array is null, then `array[i].getClass()` will throw a NullPointerException because we are trying to call a method on a null reference.

This behavior matches the bug report summary "c0.m0(Object[]) throws NPE on null array element" and description. So the root cause of the failure is that `toClass(Object[])` does not handle null elements within the passed array safely; it tries to call `getClass()` on each element without checking for null first.

The method should be fixed to add a null check inside the loop. For a null element, the corresponding entry in the resulting Class array should also be set to null rather than calling `getClass()`.

The recent bug reports do not add relevant context to this issue as they address different problems.

In summary, the root cause is the lack of null element handling in the loop inside `ClassUtils.toClass(Object[])` causing a NullPointerException when the input array has null elements.

Based on the available information, provide the signatures of the most likely culprit methods for the bug. Your answer will be processed automatically, so make sure to only answer with the accurate signatures of all likely culprits (in `ClassName.MethodName(ArgType1, ArgType2, ...)` format), without commentary (one per line).
